title: Jazzy Vietnamese Tempeh Stew
description: A vibrant, sugar‑free Vietnamese tempeh stew cooked in a dolsot stone bowl, perfect for meal‑prep with a tagine‑style simmer.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté until fragrant and translucent.
Stir in sliced bell pepper, julienned carrot, and chopped bok choy, cooking for 3 minutes.
Add diced tempeh and cook until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 400ml coconut milk and vegetable broth mixture, and add the tamarind-soy-fish sauce blend.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, reduce heat to low, cover, and let it cook for 15 minutes to meld flavors.
Stir in grated ginger, lime juice, and chili flakes, then simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro and optional chopped peanuts.
